prompt: Sprint 1: Foundations & Environment — Establish development environment, architecture decisions, and
spec_yaml:
task_id: sprint-1-foundations-environment
summary: "Establish development environment, architecture decisions, and research baseline"
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "Set up monorepo with workspace structure"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Verify that the monorepo is set up with a well-defined workspace structure."
  - id: L2
    description: "Configure CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions)"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Verify that the GitHub Actions pipeline is configured and working as expected."
  - id: L3
    description: "Define ADR template and create ADR-001 (Language/Framework Selection)"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Verify that an ADR template is defined and ADR-001 has been created with the correct language/framework selection."
  - id: L4
    description: "Literature review on attention measurement/behavioural biometrics/fraud detection"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Verify that a literature review has been conducted on the specified topics."
  - id: L5
    description: "Prototype minimal evidence ingestion → validation → storage"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Verify that a minimal prototype for evidence ingestion, validation, and storage has been developed."
  - id: L6
    description: "Threat model workshop (STRIDE)"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Verify that a threat model workshop using STRIDE has been conducted."
  - id: L7
    description: "Privacy impact assessment (DPIA) baseline"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Verify that a privacy impact assessment baseline has been established."
global_goals_refs: ["G1", "G2", "G3", "G4", "G5"]
context:
  language: TypeScript
  framework: Express
  orm: Prisma
  test_framework: Vitest
